purpose: Simulated Paperless Parts quote records shape-faithful to the public Paperless Parts REST API v3 quote/quote-item model. Feeds the console's matching engine, quote-follow-up alerts, and quote-history component of scoring. When BTX Paperless is authorized, swap providers/paperless_sample/quotes.py for the real adapter; the domain-facing shape is unchanged.

truth_rules.shape_faithful: Fields (paperless_quote_id, number, paperless_account_id, paperless_contact_id, status, sent_at, converted_at, expired_at, total_price, sales_person_user_id, estimator_user_id, parent_quote_id, line items with part_number/process_display/material_display/quantity/unit_price/lead_time_days) match the public Paperless Parts API v3 quote object.
truth_rules.no_customer_confidential: No customer part numbers or drawings. Part numbers are constructed pattern P-<ACCT>-<CLASS>-<seq>.
truth_rules.provenance: Every record is synthetic and marked data_mode=SAMPLE, synthetic=true. No real BTX customer commercial data is asserted.
truth_rules.quote_status_values: OUTSTANDING, CONVERTED, LOST, EXPIRED, CANCELLED — aligned to Paperless Parts public API status vocabulary.
